note: Reviewed Build 42 findings keyed by static receiver class and method. The remaining findings arise from SandboxOptions returning a runtime subtype through an interface.

entries.reason: Build 42 declares getOptionByName/getOptionByIndex as returning the SandboxOption interface, while Lua receives concrete BooleanSandboxOption, IntegerSandboxOption, DoubleSandboxOption, EnumSandboxOption, or StringSandboxOption instances. This checker cannot model that runtime subtype dispatch. The jar confirms the config-option implementations supply these accessors, enum translations are on EnumSandboxOption, and getClass is inherited from java.lang.Object; the callers use the option APIs according to the detected type.
